Xiao Ming hopes to persuade the boss to let him switch to a branch closer to home, so his daily commute time greatly shortens.

[Question]
How does Xiao Ming persuade the boss?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Ming can mention the positive impact of reducing commuting on environmental protection as an additional consideration.
B. He proves to the boss that he has strong self-management skills, and he works efficiently even in a new environment.

D. He suggests first trying out at the closer branch for a while to prove that work efficiency and results do not suffer.
